description:
**Repro (.pi/tmp/queue-test/probe_queue.exs)**
- Start an Agent loop with FakeTransport scripted to a single text-only turn.
- Call OctoPi.Agent.steer(loop, \"steer-1\") **before** prompt().
- Call OctoPi.Agent.prompt(loop, \"user-1\"); wait_for_idle.
- Inspect Agent.state(loop).messages — only the user prompt and assistant
  reply are present. \"steer-1\" is missing from the transcript.
- Agent.drain_steering(loop) still returns the queued message — it never
  got injected.

**Upstream behavior (tmp/pi-mono/packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts)**
\`\`\`
async function runLoop(...) {
  let firstTurn = true;
  // Check for steering messages at start (user may have typed while waiting)
  let pendingMessages = (await config.getSteeringMessages?.()) || [];   // ← L165

  while (true) {
    let hasMoreToolCalls = true;
    while (hasMoreToolCalls || pendingMessages.length > 0) {
      ...
      // Stream assistant response
      const message = await streamAssistantResponse(...);
      ...
      pendingMessages = (await config.getSteeringMessages?.()) || [];   // ← L208
    }
    ...
  }
}
\`\`\`

Upstream drains steering BEFORE the first LLM call and AFTER every turn,
regardless of stop reason.

**Octo_pi behavior (apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/loop.ex)**
- start_run/1 (L290-…) advances directly into :prompt_received without
  draining the steering queue.
- decide_next/2 only drains steering on :tool_use:
  \`\`\`elixir
  defp decide_next(:tool_use, store) do
    {steers, q} = PendingMessageQueue.drain(store.loop.steering_queue)
    ...
  end
  \`\`\`
- For all other stop reasons (:stop, :max_tokens, :error, :aborted) only
  the follow-up queue is consulted. Steering messages are stranded.

**Fix sketch**
- In start_run/1 (or just before the very first :prompt_received advance),
  drain the steering queue and prepend the items to messages.
- In decide_next/2, also drain steering for :stop / non-tool terminal stops
  *before* consulting follow_up_queue. Behaves like upstream's
  \"check steering after every turn\" then \"check follow-up only at outer loop\".
title: [BUG] Steering queue not drained at run start or after non-tool turns
